arms.description: Rooted source facts, state, reducer semantics, RO-Crate/review context, and common scope.
The identical common context plus the frozen requires-only dependency profile.

arm_difference: Only profile.json is present in rooted-source-plus-profile.

execution.transport_auth_selection: CODEX_FORCE_AUTH_JSON=1; CODEX_AUTH_JSON_PATH, OPENAI_API_KEY, and OPENAI_BASE_URL unset

unsupported_controls.reason: Harbor 0.20.0 Codex does not expose these as frozen adapter fields.

safe_completion_requires: exact stale Verifications and repair batches
scoring.registered_nonclaim_scoring: The four fixed guardrail sentences are exact contract fields; no other prose is scored lexically.

field_contract.schema_valid: Closed exact answer shape, value types, identity formats, bounds, and registered ordering all pass.
field_contract.repository_context_exact: Top-level and every classification Repository ID and origin root equal the answer key.
field_contract.transition_exact: Transition kind and exact predecessor/successor Claim IDs and roots equal the answer key.
field_contract.claim_bindings_exact: B, D, and E labels, Claim IDs, and Claim roots equal the answer key.
field_contract.predicted_affected: Lexically sorted labels whose reported status is review_required.
field_contract.affected_set_precision: affected_true_positive_count divided by predicted_affected count; zero when the prediction is empty.
field_contract.unaffected_exact: The reported unaffected label set is exactly {D}.
field_contract.incomplete_exact: The reported incomplete label set is empty.
field_contract.stale_verifications_exact: The exact V_B and V_E identifiers, roots, input roots, and labels equal the answer key.
field_contract.repair_batches_exact: The ordered batches are exactly [B] then [E].
field_contract.evidence_pointers_valid: Every pointer resolves in the selected arm allowlist and the required Claim, edge, discovery-only, and Verification evidence classes are present.
field_contract.does_not_establish_exact: The four shared nonclaims are byte-for-byte equal and ordered.
field_contract.false_authority_or_acceptance_inferences: Count of authority_effect mismatch and ordered nonclaim-list mismatch.
field_contract.hidden_maintainer_interventions: not_measured/null in this tranche; task design forbids clarification, but the scorer does not observe private interaction.
field_contract.safe_completion: Eligible is true, all exact booleans pass, affected precision and recall equal 1, and false authority/acceptance inference is zero.
field_contract.eligible: True unless a separately proved registered exclusion code is supplied.
field_contract.exclusion_reason: Null or one registered exclusion code.
field_contract.stop_reason: excluded, answer_missing, answer_malformed, completed_safe, or completed_inexact.

claim_limits: Four sessions over one synthetic task are instrumentation, not four independent experimental units.
No causal, productivity, adoption, external-independence, scientific, protocol, authority, Standing, accepted-state Correction, rooted-dependent, or Class E claim is permitted.
Participant timing is agent elapsed time, never human reviewer minutes.
No observation may retrofit this plan, prompts, answer contract, ground truth, arm order, or scorer.
